propositions: BindingStore.unbind() removes forward binding unconditionally but removes reverse binding only when jira_key exists, leaving orphaned reverse entries that fsck reports as store_integrity violations forever
Concurrent merge conflicts or out-of-band edits to bindings.json can drop forward entries without triggering their corresponding reverse cleanup, permanently stranding reverse keys in the index
No public API exists to repair orphaned reverse bindings, requiring operators to access _data directly as happened with REB-410 through REB-422
unbind() must unconditionally remove both forward and reverse entries by checking jira_key in the fast path then sweeping for any residual reverse[K]==local_id
rebar bridge fsck --repair must be added with pre-write guards verifying all orphans are reverse_missing_forward kind, not in bindings-retired.json, and have no current forward binding
